name: vigil
description: VIGIL — synthetic-data ED waiting-room reassessment research demo. NOT FOR CLINICAL USE.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.dev:api: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir app --timeout-graceful-shutdown 2
scripts.lint:api: cd services/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app
scripts.scenario:gen: cd services/api && uv run python -m app.simulator.generator --seed 42 --out ../../data/scenarios/waiting-room-30.seed-42.json
